summary: Seat lanes, step 1: an agent (top-level or in a mission) may declare `capacity cores=N memory="SIZE"`. On a Linux host whose config sets `lanes = "on"`, that seat's scope starts in app.slice/app-lanes.slice with CPUQuota, MemoryMax, MemorySwapMax (a quarter of the memory), OOMPolicy=continue and TasksMax, and its builds stay inside it (BUILDS_SLICE_ACTIVE and a lane-private sccache socket; scripts/st-test's builds.slice wrapper runs a check in place when its own cgroup is in app-lanes.slice or builds.slice). Seats without a declaration, and every seat on a host with the switch off, run as before.

replay.detail: No claim, event or replay change; the member record gains an optional field.

schema.detail: MemberSpec gains optional `capacity` (omitted when absent, so existing records and revisions are unchanged); the install config gains optional `lanes` (on|off).

rules.detail: The agent declaration accepts a `capacity` child (cores=, memory=), at most once; it is refused with bind-terminal.

compatibility.detail: An older member reading a laned record drops the field and runs the seat without a lane. An older CLI refuses a file that declares `capacity`; an older daemon refuses a config that sets `lanes` (deny_unknown_fields), so set it only on hosts that run this build.

downtime.detail: Nothing changes until a host sets `lanes = "on"` and a seat declares `capacity`; a lane applies at the seat's next start.

manual.detail: Before a host turns lanes on, its admission guard must count only OOM kills outside lanes: oom_kill(user-UID.slice) minus oom_kill(app.slice/app-lanes.slice) (docs/st3/seat-lanes.md, The host guard). Operations has been asked.

recovery.detail: Remove `lanes` from config.toml (or set it to "off") and restart the daemon; laned seats run without a lane from their next start.
